usage: zeus [-h] [--repository REPOSITORY] [--version]
            {sdd,paths,setup,init-db,execution-recovery,seed-research-backlog,doctor,status,release-abandon,release-retry,cleanup,organization,validate,demo,incident,flush,send,run-command,serve,research,improve,execute-one,cancel,rebase,artifact,index,query,embed,project-graph,rlm,context,inspect,observe,rollback-hook,canary,cycle,operate,audit-service,audit-repair,dge,fleet,host-delivery,worker-session,continuation,owner-actions,desk,autonomous,research-program,decision-feedback,ticket,goal,research-package,dlq}
            ...

Zeus: evidence, independent review, and recoverable operations

positional arguments:
  {sdd,paths,setup,init-db,execution-recovery,seed-research-backlog,doctor,status,release-abandon,release-retry,cleanup,organization,validate,demo,incident,flush,send,run-command,serve,research,improve,execute-one,cancel,rebase,artifact,index,query,embed,project-graph,rlm,context,inspect,observe,rollback-hook,canary,cycle,operate,audit-service,audit-repair,dge,fleet,host-delivery,worker-session,continuation,owner-actions,desk,autonomous,research-program,decision-feedback,ticket,goal,research-package,dlq}
    sdd                 Strict specs, observation proposals and eight-stage preparation reports
    paths               Resolved local paths and persistent namespace; no service access
    setup               Create local configuration without overwriting credentials
    execution-recovery  Explicit trusted local operator recovery; no human attestation
    observe             Observation logs: collect the spool, report status, reconcile
    cycle               Bounded persistent execution loop over one correlation; no conductor
    operate             One bounded operation: worker, evidence gate, lead review; no conductor
    audit-service       Run ONE selected source audit through the existing scheduler, Workflow and
                        executor; no release activation
    audit-repair        Opt-in, inspect and report the ONE bounded corrective successor of a
                        rejected source audit analysis
    dge                 Research-bound design control: register packet, submit debate event,
                        status
    fleet               Bounded multi-lane admission of operation manifests; no conductor
    host-delivery       Durable delivery of a reviewed release to a host target; opt-in, reuses
                        Releases approval and the ReleaseQueue fence
    worker-session      Durable Claude task sessions: read-only status, explicit close
    continuation        Opt-in conductor continuation over finite operations
    owner-actions       Server-owned research acceptance, delivery-plan and canary handoffs (opt-
                        in; approves nothing itself)
    desk                Local front-door conversation runner; no conductor, no retries
    autonomous          Research, immutable packet, independent debate, Operation v2, atomic
                        promotion
    research-program    Finite discovery program: local + live feeds -> dedup -> <=1 council per
                        tick; operator-authorized bounds
    decision-feedback   Join recorded conductor decisions with actual run outcomes and report
                        unverified recurring-work candidates; read-only, no model
    ticket              Versioned review topics and explicit GitHub issue sync
    goal                Goal manifest progress: read-only report and same-definition compare
    research-package    Research packages: record, accept, withdraw, exempt, status
    dlq                 Dead letters: list them, replay one entry exactly once

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repository REPOSITORY
                        Harness checkout (independent of current directory)
  --version             show program's version number and exit

intended_differences.authority: S10 G20-D6 (DESIGN-s10 section 14, owner 2026-10-04) and A5-1b (DESIGN-s10 section 17a): the declared target roots `research-package` and `dlq` (both in cli.parser's intended differences) join the top-level command list and its help lines; nothing else in the help changes

usage: experience.py [-h] [--source SOURCE] --basis {pinned,observed} [--revision REVISION]
                     [--path-prefix PATH_PREFIX] [--artifacts ARTIFACTS] [--dry-run]
                     paths [paths ...]

Import explicitly selected upstream lesson files; never scan user homes automatically. uv run
python -m codex_harness.entry.processes.experience DIR_OR_FILES... --basis observed --dry-run

positional arguments:
  paths                 Lesson .md files or directories (non-recursive)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source SOURCE       Upstream source name
  --basis {pinned,observed}
  --revision REVISION   Full commit SHA; required for pinned, forbidden for observed
  --path-prefix PATH_PREFIX
                        Upstream-relative directory recorded before file names
  --artifacts ARTIFACTS
  --dry-run             Parse and classify only; no database or artifact writes

intended_differences.authority: S10 E5b (DESIGN-s10 section 16 (b), owner 2026-10-04): codex_harness.adapters.experience is not kept at its M7 path (REBUILD-DESIGN-v2 section 3.5, S0's pinned-argv scan); its target entry is codex_harness.entry.processes.experience; the stdout, its sha256 and bytes change only by that dotted path (argparse usage/description text), a direct consequence of the mapping; the help description is M7's module docstring with only the module path changed

usage: observed_assets.py [-h] [--artifacts ARTIFACTS] [--dry-run] audit_id manifest

Register explicitly listed non-Git assets in an audit's observed-asset ledger. uv run python -m
codex_harness.entry.cli.observed_assets AUDIT_ID manifest.json [--dry-run] The manifest is a JSON
list of {path, basis, state, sha256, size, evidence_refs}; `path` is the raw relative path and is
stored base64-encoded like Git inventory entries (INV-RESEARCH-001).

positional arguments:
  audit_id
  manifest

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --artifacts ARTIFACTS
  --dry-run             Validate the manifest only; no database write
